title: 第16章 纯欲尤物
novel_title: 神医小傻驴的乡村女人
content_zh:
“呃，要肯定是想要的，就是……”

    李大壮有些不好意思的挠了挠头，其实他想说，自己可能做不到只有秋霜姐一个女人，谁知张桂芬却以为他是担心李秋霜不愿意跟他好，当即笑起来。

    “傻小子，只要你愿意就行，你秋霜姐对你一直有那方面的意思，之前你还傻着的时候，她都不嫌弃，想要嫁给你呢。”

    “这两年也亏了有她照顾，你才有今天，现在你终于好起来了，可不能忘恩负义啊！”

    “妈，我……”

    “行了，啥也别说了，以后我跟你爸一定多给你俩创造机会，你好好把握啊，我们就等着抱孙子了！”

    张桂芬美滋滋的，扭头去给李秋霜帮忙做饭去了。

    李大壮有些就纠结，他是真喜欢秋霜姐，却无法做到弱水三千只取一瓢饮，那这一瓢，到底还饮不饮呢？

    既然想不通，那就先不想了，先修炼一会儿再说！

    就在李大壮为了性福生活忙碌的时候，王家父子俩却被县医院告知，王耀根不但手腕和膝盖骨都粉碎性骨折了，连腰子，也彻底废了！

    “不！不可能！我还这么年轻！我还玩够女人了！咋能废了！”

    “爸！你一定要帮我找李大壮报仇！我要弄死他！弄死他啊！!”

    王耀根崩溃的大叫，引得病房的人纷纷嫌弃皱眉，这家伙不会是疯子吧，一会儿可别发起病来乱咬人，有病人家属急匆匆去找医生了！

    “弄死他？然后你做一辈子废人！？”王有财脸色阴沉，眼神却没了平时的精明，只剩下颓唐和焦急。

    可王耀根还不服的喊着：“那我这罪就白遭了！？”

    “谁让你惹上那个煞星！？你说你想弄哪个女人不行？非得去弄李秋霜！现在好了，把自己弄成了废人，我老王家的根儿，都要断在你身上了！”

    “是你说的！我是村里的太子爷，村里的姑娘随便我祸祸！再说了，你不也相中李大壮家的宅基地了？还说要抢过来给我盖个三层小洋楼当婚房！”

    王耀根理直气壮的话，让王有财彻底无语了，他算是明白啥叫自作孽不可活了！
content_en:
"Well, if it's definitely what you want, then..."

    Li Dazhuang scratched his head in embarrassment. In fact, he wanted to say that he might not be able to live alone with Sister Qiu Shuang, but Zhang Guifen thought that he was worried that Li Qiu Shuang would not want to be good to him, so she immediately laughed.

    "Silly boy, as long as you are willing, your sister Qiu Shuang has always meant that to you. When you were stupid before, she didn't even dislike you and wanted to marry you."

    "Thanks to her taking care of you in the past two years, you are where you are today. Now that you are finally getting better, you can't be ungrateful!"

    "Mom, I..."

    "Okay, don't say anything. Your dad and I will create more opportunities for you two in the future. You should seize them. We are just waiting to have grandchildren!"

    Zhang Guifen was so pleased that she turned to help Li Qiu Shuang cook.

    Li Dazhuang was a little confused. He really liked Sister Qiu Shuang, but he couldn't do it. He could only drink one ladle of water. So should he drink this ladle?

    Since you can’t figure it out, then stop thinking about it for now and practice for a while first!

    Just when Li Dazhuang was busy with his sexual life, the Wang family and his son were told by the county hospital that Wang Yaogen not only suffered comminuted fractures of his wrist and kneecap, but also his waist was completely disabled!

    "No! It's impossible! I'm still so young! I've had enough of playing with women! How can I be useless!"

    "Dad! You must help me take revenge on Li Dazhuang! I want to kill him! Kill him!!"

    Wang Yaogen's scream of collapse caused everyone in the ward to frown in disgust. This guy couldn't be a lunatic. Don't get sick and bite people indiscriminately for a while. Some of the patient's family members hurriedly went to find a doctor!

    "Kill him? Then you will be a useless person for the rest of your life!?" Wang Youcai's face was gloomy, but his eyes were not as shrewd as usual, leaving only dejection and anxiety.

    But Wang Yaogen was still dissatisfied and shouted: "Then my sin will be in vain!?"

    "Who told you to get into trouble with that evil star!? Which woman do you want to seduce? You have to get Li Qiu Shuang! Now, you have made yourself a useless person, and the roots of my old Wang family will be cut off on you!"

    "That's what you said! I'm the crown prince of the village, and I can do whatever I want to do to the girls in the village! Besides, didn't you also fall in love with the homestead of Li Dazhuang's family? You even said that you would seize it and build me a three-story Western-style building as a wedding room!"

    Wang Yaogen's confident words left Wang Youcai completely speechless. He finally understood what it means to be self-destructive!
